name: ShortestBite
description: Explore BFS, Dijkstra and A* as delivery riders navigate a procedural city or real Koramangala streets, with traffic, closures, rerouting, guided missions and a Knowledge section.

name: NimbusLab
description: A gamified cloud simulator that shows how resources really work: play through S3, GCS and Azure Blob multipart uploads with animated packets, part lanes, retries, guided missions and provider-by-provider comparisons.

name: Code Judge
description: A browser-only LeetCode-style coding judge: 245 problems, JavaScript and TypeScript judged in a Web Worker, NeetCode 250 catalog, streaks and progress, all stored locally with optional GitHub sync.
